Tom Blincoe leads medical center efforts to establish and grow collaborative relationships with organizations throughout Ohio and beyond. He and his team oversee the Ohio State Health Network and Ohio State’s TeleConsult Network. They also provide support to other Ohio State network initiatives, including the Healthy State Alliance, the Heart and Vascular Network, the James Cancer Network and a network of independent healthcare providers who use Ohio State’s electronic health record system.
